scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:db && concurrently -c "green,blue" -n "UI,API" "pnpm --filter app run dev" "pnpm run dev:api"
scripts.dev:api: sh -c 'PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH uv run --project server uvicorn server.index:app --reload --reload-dir server --port 8000'
scripts.dev:db: docker compose up -d postgres langfuse-db langfuse-web && sh -c 'until docker compose exec -T postgres pg_isready -U app -d app >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done'
